config.selection_rule: Every Monday 09:00 KST, scan all current Upbit KRW markets with the unchanged V7.6 ranking logic and buy TOP5 equally (20% each).
config.holding_rule: Each position exits at +20%, tested stop, or after 7 days. Proceeds stay idle until next weekly rebalance.
config.same_bar_rule: If TP and SL touch in the same 5m candle, stop is counted first (conservative).
config.warning: Historical replay, not clean OOS. Current-market survivorship bias exists because today's KRW market list is used.
